neighbours.label: Comma/quote/dash boundary (or the first letter of 'i.e.', 'т.е.', 'd.h.', 'c'est-à-dire') right where the text is about to restate or gloss the preceding term ('i.e.', 'that is', 'то есть', 'أي'); strongest in Russian, Arabic, German and French prose. Output promotes ' i', ' namely', '即', 'cioè'.
fire: The treatment is contraindicated in patients with advanced renal failure, i.e., those whose creatinine clearance falls below thirty.
У больного отмечается одышка, т.е. затруднённое дыхание, возникающее даже при небольшой нагрузке.
Die bisherigen Regelungen bleiben bestehen, d.h. alle Anträge müssen weiterhin bis Ende Juni eingehen.
ويقصد بالنزاهة هنا الاستقامة في السلوك، أي الالتزام بالصدق في جميع الظروف.
Notre contrat est rétroactif, c'est-à-dire qu'il s'applique aussi aux achats déjà effectués l'an dernier.
The court recognized a right of prior notice; that is, the agency may not act without first informing every affected party.
Эксперты называют такой подход «избыточным», то есть требующим от школы слишком больших ресурсов.
Two factors drive the decline in yields, namely falling demand abroad and steadily rising costs at home.
quiet: The treatment is contraindicated in patients with advanced renal failure, and it was withdrawn from several hospitals after the second review.
У больного отмечается одышка, кашель и слабость, которые усиливаются даже при небольшой нагрузке.
Die bisherigen Regelungen bleiben bestehen, aber alle Anträge werden künftig von einer neuen Stelle geprüft.
ويقصد بالنزاهة هنا الاستقامة في السلوك، وقد أكدها الفقهاء في كتبهم عبر القرون.
Notre contrat est rétroactif, mais nous n'avons malheureusement reçu aucune réponse depuis le mois dernier.
The court recognized a right of prior notice; the agency appealed, and the case was argued again in the spring.
Эксперты называют такой подход «избыточным», и многие школы уже отказались от него в этом году.
Two factors drive the decline in yields: falling demand abroad and steadily rising costs at home.

notes: 10x pilot (concept-maps/tenx, random arm): label and 16 sentences written by a fresh Sonnet 5.5 subagent from a packet (card + all-pole band samples); no probes. An Opus gate checked rule-level items only (8 + 8, 0 overlap with census and probe text, near misses free of the declared trigger) and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Top examples are all the token right before an appositive gloss (i.e./т.е./d.h./c'est-à-dire), with output promoting ' i', ' namely', 'cioè'; the neuron is very sparse (0.009% above 0.3 max) and bands show it also fires weakly on many bare commas, so near misses use commas that lead to ordinary continuations. The - pole (commas before 'which means/that is' definitions) looks related but opposite in sign, and fire items may land under 0.3 of max since the max (400) is an outlier.
